description: EX-ALIAS, the missing unheld control: r-lock-1-2 saw 3043 for the extended-length spelling in every record, with and without a holder. One process, nobody holding: OpenDatabase read-only of the plain path, of the extended (\\?\) spelling, the slashes spelling, the dot spelling and the upper-case spelling, each with Errors before/after and a count read. Asks whether 3043 is a property of the spelling alone.
